people.name: Kassem Fawaz
people.current_position: Associate Professor and Associate Chair for Research, ECE, University of Wisconsin-Madison

bio.summary: Kassem Fawaz is Associate Professor and Associate Chair for Research in Electrical and Computer Engineering at the University of Wisconsin-Madison, with an affiliation in Computer Sciences. Fawaz directs the WI-PI research group, working on security and privacy for users interacting with devices, including voice interfaces, privacy policies, malware detection, data privacy and wireless security. Fawaz earned a PhD in Computer Science and Engineering at the University of Michigan, advised by Kang G. Shin.
bio.thesis_title: Location Privacy Protection in the Mobile Era and Beyond
notable: 2019 Caspar Bowden Award for Privacy Enhancing Technologies
